name: @clue-harness/rag
description: Retrieval augmentation engine: failure-signature extraction, the RagRetriever seam (full-text now, embedding deferred by design), binding-boosted signature retrieval, the gate assist block renderer — plus M9's two-level machinery: the write-time ingest channel (extract → hash → immutable snapshot → chunk → preview), second-level queryChunks over the derived chunk ledger (heading×2/body×1, overlap dedupe, redline-aware excerpts) and the kb_detail renderer. Zero dsh dependencies — engines first, faces on demand.
